index.html.about-text-0:
We are a close-knit residential community nestled along the shores of the Chesapeake Bay in Edgewater, Maryland.

The Glebe Heights Community Association brings together neighbors who share a love for waterfront living. Our community enjoys a private beach, dock, and gathering spaces where families connect, kids play, and lifelong friendships are forged.

Whether you're new to the neighborhood or a longtime resident, there's always something happening in Glebe Heights. From holiday celebrations to summer cookouts at the fire pit, our community is what we make it together.

🏖️

Beach Area

Our sandy community beach is the heart of Glebe Heights. Perfect for swimming, sunbathing, or just watching the sunset over the water. Beach chairs are available for all residents.
index.html.amenity-1:
🚢

Community Dock

Our shared dock provides water access for fishing, kayaking, paddle boarding, and enjoying the Chesapeake Bay right from our neighborhood.
index.html.amenity-2:
🔥

Fire Pit Area

The fire pit is our primary gathering spot. It hosts our monthly meetings, holiday parties, and spontaneous neighborhood hangouts. Bring your own marshmallows!
index.html.amenity-3:
🪑

Seating & Chairs

Comfortable seating is provided throughout the beach area. Relax, read a book, or catch up with neighbors in our shared outdoor space.

updates-cards.title: Next Meeting: Monday, September 14th
content: Community meetings are the 2nd Monday of every month (April–October) at 6:30 PM at the beach fire pit area. Come share your ideas and stay in the loop.

updates-cards.title: Summer Season is Here!
content: The beach area is open and ready for the season. Chairs have been set out and the dock has been inspected. Enjoy the water safely!

updates-cards.title: Holiday Parties & Events
content: We celebrate together! From summer cookouts to fall bonfires and winter holiday gatherings, there's always a reason to get together at the community beach.

updates-cards.title: Volunteer Opportunities
content: Help keep our community spaces beautiful! We're always looking for volunteers for beach cleanups, event setup, and general maintenance. Reach out if you'd like to get involved.

updates-cards.title: Labor Day Party
content: 🎆 Join us for the Glebe Heights Community Association Labor Day party!

GHCA Monthly Meeting

July 13, 2026 • 6:30 PM • Beach Fire Pit Area

Minutes from previous meeting read and approved.

Treasury Report

Previous Balance$25,568.91
Deposits+$360
BGE-$7.34
Statewide-$0 (Greg follow up)
Service Charge-$46.57 (reconcile with Greg)
New Balance$25,875

Old Business

  • Jelly Fish Nets: Officially taken out of the water, rolled up, and weights removed. 
    • Need to store weights and decide on next steps. Nets need repair, cables need to be redone, and two poles need to be reconnected. Nets are not very effective due to lose weave and lack of float with high tide. 
    • Sheii to follow-up with quotes for new nets and repairs before the next meeting. 
  • Gate Rope and Ramp Chain/Lock: Need fixing, Pedro to fix by next work party (July 29th). Ramp lock to be cut off and replaced along with gate rope. 
  • Gate Arm Upgrade: Previously approved gate arm at $8K (originally $7.5K without backup battery) - includes back-up batter in case power goes out. Proposing $75 initiation fee/family, $25 for a new car pass (goes on license plate, registered to car and gate opens when approached, sensor prevents damage when car is going in or out).
    • Pedro to ask additional questions including: 
      • How to handle entry/exit for guest, events, contractors, etc.
      • Electrician estimate for power hookups
      • Wait period for installation
      • Emergency override procedures
  • Boat Ramp Fix: Agreed to tackle with next year's fees. 
    • Pedro to get new estimates from Jim Hatley (originally $16K)
  • Retaining Wall Fix: Need new estimates and established timeline. To discuss at next meeting. 

New Business

  • Proposal to raise yearly dues to $100/family
  • Scheduled next work party for pier and platform fixes for Wednesday, 7/29 at 5PM EST.
    • Need volunteers with woodworking/carpentry experience for pier repairs. 

Meeting adjourned.
